projects.name: Disaggregated Decoding on Heterogeneous GPU–Dataflow AI Accelerators
projects.description: Run prefill on an 8-GPU NVIDIA H200 SXM system and autoregressive decoding on Cerebras WSE-3. Develop the execution path between GPU prefill and CSL decoding, focusing on request handoff and state transfer for long-horizon agents. Optimization targets: prefill–decode coordination overhead, token latency, and throughput under concurrent requests.

projects.name: Long-Context KV Cache Management for Large-Scale Computer-Use Agents
projects.description: Tested KV-cache scheduling for 50 concurrent long-horizon agents on an 8-GPU NVIDIA H200 system. Focus on cache allocation and residency across agent sessions, balancing memory pressure, context reuse, and reliable continuation of long-running computer-use tasks.

projects.name: Distributed RL Rollout Acceleration on a 256-GPU Compute Cluster
projects.description: Tested distributed RL rollouts on 256 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs at NERSC. Built a Go task-scheduling layer around vLLM and speculative decoding to coordinate rollout execution across the cluster. Optimization targets: balanced load, lower GPU idle time, and stable execution under variable rollout lengths.

projects.alt: Agent-built Galaxy workflow graph for Hi-C contact-map generation and assembly curation.
projects.description: Built a Python/BioBlend training and evaluation environment on NERSC for agents executing peer-reviewed Galaxy IWC workflows. Ran 50 concurrent secure rollouts lasting 1.5–2 hours each. Weight-free skill evolution improved the composite workflow score from 33/100 to 51/100 (+54.5%), covering graph completion, execution completion, and result correctness.

projects.alt: CSL-LLM SDK architecture: model planning, handwritten CSL, compilation, runtime execution, and reference validation.
projects.description: Implemented CSL kernels, Python orchestration, tensor placement, and persistent state on Cerebras CS-3 at Argonne National Lab AI Testbed. Executed the complete 64-layer Qwen3.8 network on one physical WSE-3, generating two continuous sentences plus EOS (37 tokens). Functional inference is demonstrated; strict CPU numerical parity remains open.

projects.alt: Pragma HLS compiler pipeline from C++ tensor programs through spatial planning and generated CSL to numerical and protocol validation.
projects.description: Built a Python compiler with a C++ tensor frontend and CSL code generation for PE placement, communication routing, and buffer-lifetime management. The published Cerebras SDK-simulator snapshot records 141 qualified configurations, including a 25-node resident attention graph, with numerical and communication-protocol validation.

projects.name: Fused Kernel on FPGA Using HLS
projects.description: Used HLS to add dedicated buffers around fixed systolic-array IP on Xilinx U280, packaging fused operations as a custom instruction. Integrated the custom instruction with an ARM C++ compiler so software can invoke a fused hardware operation directly; the design targets local data reuse and reduced intermediate data movement.

projects.name: Accelerated Radon Transformation on FPGA Using HLS
projects.description: Built a Radon-transform stream-processing unit on Xilinx Zynq-7010 using HLS and HDL. Connected spatially arranged processing elements through a hardware pipeline, targeting continuous dataflow and parallel transform computation.
